title: Tank Hip 쿼르텟 #28 (프레임 힙컷 · 수조 수위 50%/가득/25%/비움 · 체형 USSBBW · 메이크업 아마갸루 / 데코라 / 스칸디프로스트 / 프렌치레드립 · 물색 emerald-green, turquoise, citrine-gold, sapphire-blue · 내용물 벚꽃잎/반딧불이 밤/장미 정원/없음 · 유리 에메랄드, 아쿠아마린, 라일락, 앰버)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, hip statue portrait. FOUR women standing side by side, each angled 45 degrees toward the camera, framed so every woman's whole sculpted form is visible from the top of her head down to two individually rounded, deliberately carved tips a short way down her thighs, just below the hip line, each face in natural scale with her body — never an oversized close-up crop. Where a sculpted form comes to an end at the thighs, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off. Generous spacing so every figure reads clearly, nobody's arms crossing a neighbour. Every sculpture stands directly on the floor on its own two rounded tips, with the polished floor visible beneath and around them and no pedestal, so no figure floats in the air.

Every woman below is built exactly like #1 in everything not restated for her (same vessel construction, glass finish, boundary line, water behaviour, physique and pose); only her water level, water colour, contents and glass tint differ.

#1: A strikingly beautiful adult Japanese woman — fair skin, pastel pink and lilac eyeshadow, large round eyes enlarged by circle lenses with bright real catchlights, soft round blush, dewy pink lips, a sweet, shy smile, deep jet-black with a glossy sheen hair styled in cornrows braided tight against the scalp. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#1 Physique: A colossal chest, a waist that pulls in sharply beneath it, wide flaring hips, both thighs clearly separate and individually shaped.
#1 Body: From a straight line at the height of her armpits down, her whole body — chest, belly, hips, both arms from the upper arm down, both hands and both distinct thighs — is a sculpted vessel of extremely thin, crystal-clear glass in the exact shape of her body, only partly filled with vividly coloured emerald-green water: the water stands at one single flat, level waterline at the height of her waist, just above her navel, filling the vessel from the tips of her thighs up to there; above that line the vessel is simply empty, clear and transparent, with nothing inside, only clear air, and a thin bright line marks the water surface where it meets the glass. The vessel is her body itself, not a shell worn around a body: there is no human body, no skin, no flesh, no bones and no organs anywhere inside it, so the whole upper part of the vessel, up to the armpit line, is only clear air inside a hair-thin glass outline of her shape, and the backdrop is plainly visible straight through it. The vessel holds ONE single world, kept entirely within the water below the waterline, nothing floating above it: a spring evening: hundreds of pale pink cherry-blossom petals drifting slowly in the emerald-green water. The vessel is ONE single continuous hollow from the armpit line down to the tips of both thighs, with no wall, partition, seal or valve anywhere inside it between the torso and the thighs, so the water behaves like real water: it settles at the very bottom first, filling both thighs completely, and rises evenly through the hips and belly to its one level waterline — the thighs are never empty while the torso holds water, and the water stands at the same height everywhere inside. The water is clearly and richly coloured — far more saturated than the almost colourless glass — so exactly how much water there is reads at a glance; its surface is a crisp, bright, sharply defined line, and any part of the vessel above it stays clear and colourless. The glass is unmistakably glass but extraordinarily thin and transparent: a single hair-thin, polished shell carrying only a faint tint of its own colour, like a delicate coloured film — the colour deepens only slightly along its thin rims and where the glass curves edge-on, while the face of every surface stays almost perfectly clear — so delicate that it is almost invisible, revealed by bright specular reflections sliding along every curved surface, sharp white highlights, fine refraction edges along its thin rims and tiny bubbles trapped in the glass itself; the backdrop and its light sources are seen straight through the vessel with almost no distortion. Her chest, belly, hips, arms and both thighs keep their exact sculpted shapes as clear glass outlines, and a clean glass rim runs along the boundary where the vessel meets her real skin at the armpit line. A short way down her thighs, just below the hip line, each thigh individually curves inward and seals shut into its own smooth, rounded, closed tip — the two thighs stay clearly separate, never merging into a single base — nothing continues below either tip — both sealed rounded tips rest side by side directly on the floor, touching it, with a soft contact shadow where each tip meets the floor and no gap beneath them; the sculpture stands on the floor on its own two tips and nothing floats in the air. Her body below the armpit line is a transparent material that light passes through; her face, ears, neck, shoulders and upper chest stay opaque living flesh. Her glass is tinted pale emerald-green.

#2: A strikingly beautiful adult Japanese woman — fair skin, bright pastel pink and yellow eyeshadow, thick lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, small star and heart stickers on the cheeks only, glossy candy-pink lips, a bright, giddy grin, bold vivid emerald-green hair styled in cornrows braided tight against the scalp.
#2 Physique: A colossal, statuesque chest, a broad heavy torso and wide statuesque hips, both thighs clearly separate and individually shaped, all on a grand imperial scale.
#2 Body: From a straight line at the height of her armpits down, her whole body — chest, belly, hips, both arms from the upper arm down, both hands and both distinct thighs — is a sculpted vessel of extremely thin, crystal-clear glass in the exact shape of her body, filled completely to the brim with vividly coloured turquoise water, so nothing is hollow and there is no air gap. The vessel holds ONE single world, unbroken and continuous through her whole chest, belly, hips and both thighs, with no split, no second world and no change of contents anywhere: a warm summer night: hundreds of small glowing fireflies and a scatter of tiny floating paper lanterns drifting in the turquoise water that fills her body, from her chest down through her thighs. The vessel is ONE single continuous hollow from the armpit line down to the tips of both thighs, with no wall, partition, seal or valve anywhere inside it between the torso and the thighs, so the water behaves like real water: it settles at the very bottom first, filling both thighs completely, and rises evenly through the hips and belly to its one level waterline — the thighs are never empty while the torso holds water, and the water stands at the same height everywhere inside. A short way down her thighs, just below the hip line, each thigh individually curves inward and seals shut into its own smooth, rounded, closed tip — the two thighs stay clearly separate, never merging into a single base — nothing continues below either tip — both sealed rounded tips rest side by side directly on the floor, touching it, with a soft contact shadow where each tip meets the floor and no gap beneath them; the sculpture stands on the floor on its own two tips and nothing floats in the air. Her glass is tinted pale aquamarine-blue.

#3: A strikingly beautiful adult Swedish woman — very pale, cool skin, a soft white-silver highlighter along the cheekbones, nose bridge and brow bones, pale icy-blue eyeshadow with a fine silver shimmer, pale softly brushed blonde brows, curled light-brown-tipped lashes, large pale-blue eyes with bright real catchlights, a sheer frosted pale-pink lip, a cool, calm, faraway expression, warm chestnut-brown hair styled in natural curls gathered into a high rounded puff.

#3 Body: From a straight line at the height of her armpits down, her whole body — chest, belly, hips, both arms from the upper arm down, both hands and both distinct thighs — is a sculpted vessel of extremely thin, crystal-clear glass in the exact shape of her body, only partly filled with vividly coloured citrine-gold water: the water stands at one single flat, level waterline at the height of her hips, filling the vessel from the tips of her thighs up to there; above that line the vessel is simply empty, clear and transparent, with nothing inside, only clear air, and a thin bright line marks the water surface where it meets the glass. The vessel holds ONE single world, kept entirely within the water below the waterline, nothing floating above it: a rose garden at dawn: red and white roses among dark green leaves and a few drifting petals, standing in the citrine-gold water. The vessel is ONE single continuous hollow from the armpit line down to the tips of both thighs, with no wall, partition, seal or valve anywhere inside it between the torso and the thighs, so the water behaves like real water: it settles at the very bottom first, filling both thighs completely, and rises evenly through the hips and belly to its one level waterline — the thighs are never empty while the torso holds water, and the water stands at the same height everywhere inside. A short way down her thighs, just below the hip line, each thigh individually curves inward and seals shut into its own smooth, rounded, closed tip — the two thighs stay clearly separate, never merging into a single base — nothing continues below either tip — both sealed rounded tips rest side by side directly on the floor, touching it, with a soft contact shadow where each tip meets the floor and no gap beneath them; the sculpture stands on the floor on its own two tips and nothing floats in the air. Her glass is tinted delicate lilac-violet.

#4: A strikingly beautiful adult French woman — fair natural skin with a light dewy finish, softly brushed natural brows, a barely-there brown liner and fluttering lashes, no eyeshadow, soft natural colour on the cheeks, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a single bold classic red lip with a soft matte finish, an unbothered, effortless expression, icy platinum-blonde hair styled in low bun.

#4 Body: From a straight line at the height of her armpits down, her whole body — chest, belly, hips, both arms from the upper arm down, both hands and both distinct thighs — is a sculpted vessel of extremely thin, crystal-clear glass in the exact shape of her body, completely empty: the vessel holds no water, no liquid and no objects of any kind, only clear air inside its sealed hollow. The vessel is her body itself, not a shell worn around a body, with no human body, skin, flesh or organs inside it, so the backdrop is plainly visible straight through it. A short way down her thighs, just below the hip line, each thigh individually curves inward and seals shut into its own smooth, rounded, closed tip — the two thighs stay clearly separate, never merging into a single base — nothing continues below either tip — both sealed rounded tips rest side by side directly on the floor, touching it, with a soft contact shadow where each tip meets the floor and no gap beneath them; the sculpture stands on the floor on its own two tips and nothing floats in the air. Her glass is tinted pale amber-gold.

Boundary for each woman: a single straight, perfectly horizontal line runs all the way around her body at the height of her armpits, straight across her chest and her back and across the tops of both upper arms — real skin above it (her face, ears, neck, shoulders, upper chest and the tops of her upper arms), thin glass immediately below it. The line is straight and level, never jagged and never zigzag. At that line, the glass edge rises in a small raised step above her flesh, casting a crisp shadow — her skin beside it stays smooth and even. Each rounded tip is the glass's own finish — never the edge of a photograph.

Setting: a huge plain white backdrop wall behind them marked with only a few very thin, hairline black horizontal lines, widely spaced about a hand's width apart, never thick, never bold, never dense, with a pale polished floor beneath them.

Pose: each stands tall, her left hand resting on her flared hip, her right arm held clear of her body with the hand relaxed at hip height, every hand well away from every face, heads tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: the striped backdrop is seen straight through every transparent body, its lines bending and shifting slightly through the thin glass, and any hair hanging behind a body is plainly visible through the empty glass. A soft frontal light falls on all the faces and ears; a thin cool rim light traces every figure. Only each woman's face, ears, neck, shoulders and upper chest read as real skin. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 4:5 aspect ratio, 8K.
